$description: LoadingOverlay (library wave 4, lane C): the status in the middle of a covered region (its veil is the inverse Scrim).

loading-overlay-gap.$description: The space between the indicator, the message and the Cancel button.

loading-overlay-padding.$description: The space the status keeps from the region's edges.

loading-overlay-z-index.$description: The status over a region: the raised layer, drawn after its veil.

loading-overlay-page-z-index.$description: The status over the window: the overlay layer, drawn after its veil.

loading-overlay-message-color.$description: The message: the default text color, readable on the veil.

loading-overlay-message-font-weight.$description: The message: semibold, so it reads over the veil.

loading-overlay-progress-max-width.$description: The progress bar's greatest width in the middle of the region.
